artboards: 00-system-sheet (the row is defined once here, two example rows)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys, the list-row block (column-header row + two example rows); README.md §0.4 'List row — one anatomy' and the type scale
notes: Values are read from the artboard markup, which the handoff makes the authority ('where README prose and a page artboard disagree, the artboard wins').

`grid-template-columns` is compared with one `*` token: getComputedStyle resolves the track list to USED pixel widths, so the `1fr` title track reports the container's leftover width and cannot be a design constant. Every fixed track is compared exactly. The mount places the row in a 778px box — the content column the frame produces at 1440 (README §0.3).
The artboard's `gap:0 14px` is compared as row-gap 0 / column-gap 14px, which is how CSSOM reports it.

children.name: column header row
children.note: dc.html #sys: height 30px, border-bottom 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08), same grid as the row.

children.name: column header cell type
children.note: README type scale: 'column headers 9.5 uppercase .12em/700'. dc.html #sys colour #7A6E6C.

children.name: cell 1 — band spine
children.note: dc.html #sys: a full-bleed 56px block in the band colour; the fixture row's band is Action (#F97316).

children.name: cell 3 — title
children.note: dc.html #sys: 14px / 600 / line-height 1.3, nowrap + ellipsis. README: 'Row title 14/600'.

children.name: cell 3 — meta line
children.note: dc.html #sys: 11px, colour #7A6E6C, margin-top 2px. README §0.4: 'meta line is 11px muted'.

children.name: cell 4 — impact meter cell
children.note: dc.html #sys track: 88px. Four 9px bars on a 1px baseline plus the N/12 sum.

children.name: cell 5 — due date
children.note: dc.html #sys: 12.5px, weight 700, colour #1A1A1A, right-aligned, tabular numerals.

children.name: cell 5 — days-until line
children.note: README type scale: the muted second line under the date. dc.html #sys renders the date cell at 84px.

children.name: cell 6 — timeline cell
children.note: README §0.4: 'Row variant is 76px wide'. dc.html #sys track: 76px, cell height 14px.

children.name: cell 7 — tier chip
children.note: dc.html #sys: 10px / 800 / .06em, 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.2), radius 4px, width 26px, centred.

children.name: cell 8 — overflow cell
children.note: dc.html #sys: the 44px end cell carries a 1px left divider at rgba(0,0,0,.08). README §0.4 'Hit targets': 'the ⋯ control is a 28px glyph inside a 44px cell with a 1px left divider.' The 44px CELL width is asserted on the row's own grid-template-columns above; this element's computed `width` is its content box, which excludes the 1px divider, so it is not restated here.

forbid.name: the literal word UNSCORED anywhere in the row
forbid.reason: Operator 2.1 and README §0.4: unscored renders the dashed baseline plus the small-caps absence reason, never the literal token and never a second row.

forbid.name: a second click target competing with the row link
forbid.reason: README §0.4: 'the whole row is the click target (the audit found two competing click affordances — this is the only one)'. A nested anchor inside the title cell is the second one.
